# UBS Fuel Trading L.L.C.

> UBS Fuel Trading L.L.C. is a Dubai-based fuel and bunker supplier in the United Arab Emirates. It supplies marine fuels and bulk diesel — Marine Gas Oil (MGO), Low Sulphur Marine Gas Oil (LSMGO), Ultra Low Sulphur Diesel (ULSD), IFO 30, IFO 180, HFO 380 and blended fuel oils — by its own road tanker fleet to 25 ports, jetties and commercial sites across six emirates, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## Key facts

- Business: fuel supplier, bulk diesel supplier and bunker (marine fuel) supplier in the UAE
- Head office: Office 450, Al Qusais Industrial Area 2, P.O. Box 234802, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Branch offices: Musaffah (Abu Dhabi), Hamriyah Free Zone (Sharjah), Al Jurf 2 (Ajman)
- Own fleet: 28 road tankers, 13,500 gallons each
- Storage: 1,300 MT fuel storage facility in Ajman
- Delivery size: 5 MT to 50 MT per delivery
- Service hours: 24/7, including out-of-hours and emergency deliveries
- Quality: marine fuels supplied to ISO 8217 specifications
- Commercial terms: bulk-purchase pricing and flexible payment terms
- Customers: ship owners, operators, traders, and industrial and commercial companies

## Areas served

- Dubai: Dubai Maritime City, Dubai Drydocks, Port Rashid, Jebel Ali Port, Dubai Palm Deira, Hamriya Port
- Abu Dhabi: CCC Jetty, Al Masoud Jetty, Mina Zayed, Al Jaber Jetty, Yas Marina, Khalifa Port
- Sharjah: Port Khalid, Hamriyah Free Zone Port, Khorfakkan Port, Kalba Port
- Ajman: Ajman Port, Sixco Jetty, AHI Jetty
- Ras Al Khaimah: Mina Saqr, Al Jazeera Port, Stevin Rock Jetty, RAK Maritime City, Khor Port
- Umm Al Quwain: Umm Al Quwain Port
